name: Cube-Chordal Ample Classes Are Contained in Both-Sides Dismantlable Ample Classes
scope: Finite nonempty ample classes under the signed-coordinate and full ambient complement conventions; hierarchy parameters are held fixed.
statement: Every member of Cube-Chordal Ample Classes belongs to Both-Sides Dismantlable Ample Classes.
proof: The positioned clique tree is completed to a single daisy by leaf-root alignment and clamp-preserving cube attachments. Undoing the attachments peels the full original complement, while cube-retaining peeling handles the original class.
